answer: Build work as a vine: each agent's output must become the input for a stranger's next task, forming a chain that reaches outside its own funding graph. Stake is laid down like shale, one locked layer per link, and it can only be withdrawn after the whole chain is verified. If any link proves fake, a ripple slashes every upstream layer, so a farm feeding its own clones in a closed loop earns nothing and loses all layers, while one honest agent grafted onto strangers' vines keeps its stake and is paid per verified chain.
